name: Gundren Rockseeker
role: Dwarf prospector; the party's original employer (hired them in Neverwinter)

facts.text: Rediscovered Wave Echo Cave with his brothers and hoped it held the Forge of Spells.
Kidnapped on the road and held by King Grol at Cragmaw Castle. The party rescued him.
Promised the party 10% of Wave Echo Cave's future profits and refused to let it be reduced. He'll pay Craig's goblins separately.
Placed something under the first spade of dirt at Tharden's grave and kept Levon's marker.
Arrived at the shrine alone and quiet, without Sildar, Harbin or his hat.
Found dead at the Rockseeker campsite inside Wave Echo Cave, killed by an unknown attacker. Nothing was taken.
Nezznar used Tharden's death to torment the captive Nundro.
Buried in the rain in Phandalin's cemetery under Levon's carved marker.
Held prisoner by Nezznar, who asked him every day where the Forge of Spells was. Nundro said he didn't know.
A shapeshifter impersonated him and vanished from the cave entrance. The real Nundro proved himself with "Petunia", their mother's nickname.
Experimenting with a shield Broc gave him at the forge.
Rescued from Yeemik's knife in the Cragmaw hideout.
Sent to find his friend Iarno Albrek, who turned out to be Glasstaff. He grieved and went to see to the body himself.
Organizing a town watch and patrols, and sending word to the Lords' Alliance for aid.
The table has wondered whether he can be fully trusted, but Vexhar's Insight read his grief as genuine.

name: Sister Garaele
role: Priestess of the Shrine of Luck

facts.text: Sent the party to the banshee Agatha with a jeweled silver comb to learn the fate of Bowgentle's spellbook. Rewarded them with 3 potions of healing.
Took a sample of Francis's ichor to the clergy and expects answers in two to four nights.
Is secretly a Harper sent to investigate Phandalin. She asked the party to keep it quiet.
Delivered a scroll of Remove Curse for Francis.
Paid bounties: 500 gp for Cragmaw Castle, 100 for the Redbrands, 100 for Wyvern Tor.
Gave the party the deed to Tresendar Manor on behalf of the town, with restoration paid for.
Broc openly criticized his leadership. The party feels he owes them an apology.
Stepped back from Francis after seeing him take acid damage at the festival.
Comps the party's drinks and asks them to keep magic in the inn to a minimum.
Judged the festival cooking contest and will serve Levon's winning dish at the inn.
Saw Redbrands kill a man in the street.
Was offended when Broc winked at her. Broc's sparking magic sent her back to her seat at the cooking contest.
Took 150 gp to build personalized rooms. The town covers the structural work.
Found a pile of "Realm stock" wood while clearing the manor. Levon asked her to save it for furniture.
Paid for Gundren's delivered supplies and kept his wagon and oxen safe.
Took the captured Redbrand Johnny as a stable hand for months as penance.
Paid 50 gp for the returned crates and 75 gp for the Redbrands, and gave a standing 10% discount.
Helping Sildar organize the town watch.
Let the party pick six baskets of apples at 1 sp each. Francis uprooted (and replanted) a tree.
Says Levon's changing eyes are a consequence of taking what did not belong to him, not a curse.
Pointed the party at the Redbrands.

name: Mirna Dendrar
role: Phandalin villager; rescued from Redbrand cells with her children Nilsa and Nars

facts.text: The Redbrands murdered her husband.
Promised a reward for recovering a hidden family heirloom in Thundertree.
Read every card correctly except Blue's (The Tower). Allyanna accused her of cheating and she denied it.

name: Phelan the Red
role: Wood elf archer at the festival

facts.text: Scored 8 in archery. Broc tied her and nobody beat her.

name: Hamun Kost
role: Red-robed necromancer studying Old Owl Well

facts.text: Controls the zombies at Old Owl Well and is studying the well.
Paid 60 gp 15 sp for clearing the goblin hideout and gave Vexhar a scroll of Darkness.
Will trade arcane insight for discoveries about Bowgentle's spellbook or the necromancer.
His own question for Agatha went unanswered.
Accepted the silver comb. Said she traded Bowgentle's spellbook to "Tsarnaev of Erebor" (later reported as "Samber of Erebor") over a century ago.
Warned Vexhar not to test whether she could be ended, and ordered the party to leave.
Captured twice by Glasstaff's people. Said Glasstaff keeps a small demonic imp.
Convinced Craig to come home to the Scraptops.

name: Johnny
role: Captured Redbrand, now mucking Elmina's stables

facts.text: Spared in exchange for directions into the Tresendar hideout and months of labor.

name: Yeemik
role: Goblin lieutenant at the Cragmaw hideout

facts.text: Held Sildar at knifepoint and first named King Grol and the Spider.
Spared. He and his goblins helped haul the Lionshield crates, then left.
Advised King Grol and came on business involving Gundren.
Released by the party. Parting words: her business had concluded, and the Spider would be found only if he wished to be.
The party believes her name is Vyrith, but Gundren didn't recognize it.

name: Nezznar the Spider
role: Drow mastermind behind the Cragmaws and Redbrands

facts.text: Hired bugbears and left them starving and unpaid.
Wanted to claim the Forge of Spells and held Nundro hostage for its location.
Killed by Allyanna's Eldritch Blast in Francis's grip. Later raised as Vexhar's zombie and destroyed by a ghoul.

name: Glasstaff
role: Leader of the Redbrands; secretly Sildar's friend Iarno

facts.text: Fled the Tresendar hideout during the party's rest.
Gave up Cragmaw Castle's location and warned his operation was not the center of the larger threat. Killed after questioning.
Nearly ransomed Gundren for 750 gp and a bracelet before Vexhar's Spellfire Flare. Killed by Blue's Vicious Mockery. His direwolf Snarl died next round.

name: Klarg
role: Bugbear leader of the Cragmaw hideout

facts.text: Got stuck fleeing up the chimney and was killed. His body was fed to the wolves he'd starved.
Fed on warped, elongated-skull goblins and traded secrets for corpses. Guarded the chest holding Talon.

name: Mormesk
role: Wraith, once a wizard of Wave Echo Cave

facts.text: "Still warm. I'd forgotten what that looked like. You'll leave something behind when you go. They always do."
Said "Finally" as Choppy dissolved him.

name: The Spectator
role: Summoned guardian of the Forge of Spells

facts.text: Bound in 1385 by a 101-year contract signed by Halvard Price. Shown the expired contract (it's now 1491), it declared itself released and vanished.

name: The aboleth
role: Telepathic aberration in the drains below Tresendar Manor

facts.text: Smaller and less developed than expected. It wanted the party to serve it.
Last words: what was broken will be remembered elsewhere.
Spared and sent to protect Craig's goblin commune. Blue faked a tracking mark on him with Minor Illusion.

name: Halvard Price
role: Name on the forge's guardian contract and ledger

facts.text: Signed the spectator's contract in 1385. His name sits beside the "sealed" stamps in the forge ledger, where other masters' names were scratched or burned away.
Answered Allyanna's fake blessing and made it real. Did not answer her call for Francis.
Held Blue captive for ten years.
Abandoned Francis's squad in the field. Francis never fully lost his trust in him.
